themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and refactoring code, often integrating with IDEs and version control systems.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and applications specifically designed to aid researchers in tasks like literature review, data analysis, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications that condense large volumes of text or data into shorter, digestible summaries for quicker understanding.

themes.name: AI-assisted recruitment
themes.description: Details AI tools and processes used in the hiring pipeline, from candidate sourcing and screening to interview analysis and job matching.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and employment trends, including AI's role in job displacement and the creation of new roles.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles comparing the effectiveness, features, and performance of different AI tools for research purposes.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze and interpret user feedback, reviews, and social media comments to gauge sentiment.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers how AI is being integrated into product development workflows, from ideation and feature prioritization to release management.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles specifically discussing the use, impact, and perception of AI chatbots in various research and user interaction contexts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
